records.text: Owens said Benjamin Netanyahu was insisting Andreessen Horowitz be part of a group buying TikTok because they regarded it as important for future psychological warfare
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: You should also know that he is the father—or stepfather—to Andreessen Horowitz, the one that Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu) is insisting should be a part of this group that buys TikTok because—and this is relevant—they think it's important for warfare, psychological warfare in the future.

verification.notes: Verified as a claim about what Owens said. The episode records Owens saying Netanyahu was insisting on Andreessen Horowitz's participation because TikTok mattered for future psychological warfare. Current reporting independently confirms that Andreessen Horowitz led the planned U.S. investor group and that Netanyahu publicly described social media as a weapon and the TikTok acquisition as the most important purchase. The external sources do not independently establish that Netanyahu personally selected or insisted on Andreessen Horowitz; they corroborate the two public components of Owens's statement.

records.text: Zionists purchased views, influencers, and journalists, activated millions of bots, and staged a takeover of TikTok because young people sympathized with Palestine.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Over the last three years, especially we have watched Zionists bend the fabric of reality. They have purchase views, influencers, and journalists. ... They have activated millions of online bots. They even went so far as to stage an open takeover of TikTok when they grew incensed that the youth was sympathetic to Palestine.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 37:10 is a broad composite accusation. Current FARA-based research documents Israeli-funded influencer campaigns and a bot-based amplification program, and TikTok's U.S. business was transferred to a new investor group after federal divestiture pressure. But available evidence does not establish millions of activated bots, a unified group called 'Zionists' purchasing journalists, or that the TikTok ownership deal was staged specifically because youth sympathized with Palestine. Some components are supported; the sweeping causal framing is not.

records.text: The Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office said the person reported for live-streamed self-harm was safely recovered, taken by fire rescue to a hospital for medical attention, and confirmed by family to have been alone in the residence
records.speaker: Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office

appearances.snippet: And he what the police said that they responded to his Miami area home of the celebrity blogger and podcaster Perez Hilton after they received reports that he engaged in self. self-harm in a live streamed video Tuesday night. A spokesperson for the Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office said in an email that the deputies responded to reports of someone who was live streaming acts of self-harm on social media. In a follow-up statement, the sheriff's office said that the person was safely recovered and taken by Miami-Dade Fire Rescue to a local hospital where he was receiving medical attention. It said the deputy spoke to the family members at the scene who confirmed the person had been alone inside the residence.

verification.notes: NBC6 reported the Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office response to calls about livestreamed self-harm, that the individual was alone when deputies arrived, and that paramedics transported the person. The sheriff's quoted statement said the individual was safely recovered and taken by Miami-Dade Fire Rescue to a local hospital for medical attention; later reporting confirms the hospitalization. The statement is supported.
